method: Every decoded quarter-speed canvas frame; grayscale gradients in +-24 pixel casting-bounded side-edge bands, robust line fits excluding end castings. Angles come from raster pixels, not the motion labels. No clock or named-pose injection.
limits: Witness bands localize the actual edges; this is raster/geometry correspondence rather than independent recovery of reference world-space motion.
Recorder PTS starts at the first decoded frame; nearest RAF observation is used without time fitting.
Reference fidelity, absolute trajectory radius and overall appearance still require user review.
